hooks.name: EU AI compliance — tool
hooks.description: Checks every write and shell tool call against the EU AI compliance policy service (POST /v1/check) before it runs. BLOCK denies the tool call, ASK asks a human, WARN allows with obligations shown, ALLOW is silent — emitted as hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision on exit 0, with a non-zero exit as the fallback block. The matcher targets built-in write and shell tools plus all MCP tools. Requires guardrails-hook on PATH and the service reachable at GUARDRAILS_URL (default http://127.0.0.1:8080). Copy to .kiro/hooks/ in the project (or ~/.kiro/hooks/ for every workspace).
